summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Paramount International MUN website. All backend APIs (23/23 tests) and frontend flows passed successfully. The application is fully functional and production-ready.

Backend: Registration without referral charges ₹2000 (Standard tier)
Backend: Registration without accepted_terms correctly returns 400 error
Backend: Admin login works with correct credentials, rejects wrong credentials (401)
Backend: All admin endpoints require Bearer token (401 without auth)
Backend: Admin stats, registrations, committees, referral codes endpoints work
Backend: PATCH operations work (registration status, committee metadata, portfolio status)
Backend: Portfolio status update correctly reduces open_count
Frontend: Home page loads with hero section, date (9-10 Oct 2026), countdown timer
